item.title: ‘Powerless’: Muskegon mom concerned about community safety
item.description: After gunshots were fired outside her Muskegon home, a woman decided to take her fear and frustration to city leaders as a call for help.

item.title: No injuries reported in overnight trailer home fire in Portage
item.description: A trailer home in Portage was damaged in an early morning fire Saturday, officials said.

item.title: Search and rescue expert weighs in on Lake Odessa teen disappearance
item.description: In the search for Devlin Tait, investigators are asking people in Ionia, Barry and Eaton Counties to keep their eyes open for anything that might be connected to his disappearance.

item.title: Village of Hesperia under boil water advisory months after main break caused weekslong advisory
item.description: The village of Hesperia is under a boil water advisory once again after failing a monthly water test, officials announced Friday. The announcement comes just months after a water main break prompted a two-week-long boil water advisory in the village.

item.title: Four new astronauts arrive at the International Space Station to replace NASA's evacuated crew
item.description: The International Space Station returned to full strength with Saturday’s arrival of four new astronauts to replace colleagues who bailed early because of health concerns.

item.title: Law enforcement block road near Nancy Guthrie's home during investigation into her disappearance
item.description: Law enforcement investigating the disappearance of “Today” show host Savannah Guthrie 's mother sealed off a road near Nancy Guthrie's home in Arizona late Friday night.

item.title: Newly built-home near Muskegon Costco destroyed in fire
item.description: A still-under construction home near the newly-opened Fruitport Township-area Costco was destroyed in a fire late Saturday morning.

item.title: TSA agents are working without pay at US airports due to another shutdown
item.description: A shutdown of the U.S. Department of Homeland Security that took effect early Saturday impacts the agency responsible for screening passengers and bags at airports across the country.
